hooks.command: sh -lc 'set -e; name=$(jq -r "if type == \"object\" and (.name | type == \"string\") then .name else \"worktree\" end | gsub(\"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+\"; \"-\") | sub(\"^[._-]+\"; \"\") | sub(\"[._-]+$\"; \"\") | if length > 0 then . else \"worktree\" end"); repo=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel); repo_slug=$(basename "$repo" | LC_ALL=C tr -cs "A-Za-z0-9._-" "-" | sed "s/^[._-]*//;s/[._-]*$//"); [ -n "$repo_slug" ] || repo_slug=repo; target="$HOME/.claude/worktrees/$repo_slug/$name"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"; if git -C "$repo" fetch origin >&2; then base=origin/HEAD; else base=HEAD; fi; git -C "$repo" worktree add -b "claude/$name" "$target" "$base" >&2; post="$target/scripts/worktree-post-create.sh"; if [ -f "$post" ]; then (cd "$target" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$target" CLAUDE_WORKTREE_DIR="$target" sh "$post") >&2; fi; printf "%s\n" "$target"'
